page0.text:
"Damn it, what's going on...!?"
Clearly, something is happening in the backyard.
So much of the nauseating, spiteful vortex of energy is leaking out that I can even touch it.
You don't need to be a mage to know that something's wrong.

page1.text:
"Wha..."
I thought I was ready, but I'm dumbstruck by what I find.
Tohsaka's covered in the Shadow that looks like coal tar.
Illya's watching from the edge of the yard, and Saber's standing in front of her.
And in the very middle, Sakura has a hand thrust out at Tohsaka...

page2.text:
"SAKURA!!!"
I dash into the yard.
I can't neglect any of them, but right now, Tohsaka's in the most danger.
She looks deathly pale beneath the coal tar, and her life will be in danger unless she gets help right away.

page3.text:
"Tohsaka...! Hey, get a grip, stupid!"
...
I lift her up, but she doesn't respond.
"Kuh! Hold on, I'll get this stuff off you!"

page4.text:
I tear at the mud covering her.
But despite being a liquid, the mud behaves like elastic rubber.
I can't get a decent handhold on it, and it bounces back as soon as I tear it off...!

page5.text:
"Rrgh...! What it this!? It can touch Tohsaka, so why can't I...!?"
I can't tear the mud off, no matter how hard I try.
In the chaos and confusion, I keep trying to pull the mud off Tohsaka.

page6.text:
And then...
"It's no use, Senpai. Only I can dispel my own shadow. With your skill level, it'll only consume you, instead."
"Sakura?"
Sakura speaks in a cold voice I don't know.

page7.text:
"Sakura...your face."
My scattered mind grinds to a halt.

page8.text:
Sakura's neck...
Something that looks like a tattoo is spreading over it.
It doesn't look like it at all, but that's...a Command Spell.
Sakura's body is writhing with Command Spells I don't understand.

page9.text:
"...What a surprise. You came so quickly, Senpai.
But you must be panicking. You saw what happened to Nii-san, but you aren't scolding me."
"Rgh... not now. We don't need to talk about Shinji right now. It can wait until you calm down."

page10.text:
...That's right.
I need to talk to Sakura now.
Zouken said all kinds of stuff, but he was lying.
Sakura is still Sakura.
So if we can just talk, she'll go back to—

page11.text:
"No. I don't want to talk about that, and I don't want to talk to you. I'm the only one who needs to speak.
You, Nee-san, my brother, and all the people in this town can't speak out against me anymore."

page12.text:
"..."
My hair stands on end.
This is worse than any chill.
A sharp spike of extreme cold runs from my medulla down to the bottom of my spine, like a knife opening up my back.

page13.text:
"Anyway, Senpai. Why are you protecting my sister?"
...
For an instant, my vision goes blank.
A shadow rises behind Sakura.

page14.text:
"Ah..."
The chill running down my back crystallizes into ice-cold terror encasing my entire body.
That's...Sakura.
When people told me that she's the Shadow, I was able to bear it.
But I can't deny what I just saw.

page15.text:
All it took was a touch to melt my left arm.
That emotionless killing machine slaughtering people all over town was...Sakura.

page16.text:
"Saku...ra..."
My throat feels tight.
My eyeballs spasm, and the world seems to
warp and twist around me.
Every cell in my body screams in warning, and I desperately try to snap myself out of my frozen terror.

page17.text:
But I can't.
Sakura's presence. It's no longer human. No longer Sakura.
I haven't been swallowed by this titanic magical energy yet.
There's only one reason I can't move:
Sakura's boundless bloodlust is directed at me.

page18.text:
"You've always been like that. You said you would protect me, but you never had eyes only for me.
It's all right, though. I wanted you because that's the kind of person you are."

page19.text:
My vision warps.
My mind is crumbling as I hear the words of this Sakura I don't know.
It creaks in denial.
It protests that this isn't Sakura.
Forbidden thoughts bury themselves in my mind.

page20.text:
"Is it painful to see me here, Senpai?
I know how much of a burden I am to you. You'll keep suffering as long as I'm here.
That's why I needed to disappear in front of you."

page21.text:
Shadows dance.
The ground of the backyard reminds me of a shadow puppet stage.

page22.text:
"But I can't. You're the only thing that's ever made me happy.
And you can't stay away from me, either. You can't betray yourself any further."

page23.text:
"...Yes. So I'll kill you, for your own good. That way, we can be together forever...
And you won't have to suffer anymore."

page24.text:
The shadows reach for me.
They swell into a wave bent on swallowing both me and Tohsaka.

page25.text:
In my battered mental state, I shove Tohsaka away.
The black wave descends on me.
I don't even try to evade it.
...
I was terrified.
The mere instant I thought that this Sakura isn't Sakura anymore,
the realization stopped me from moving my body.

page26.text:
...I know this.
I've bathed in this darkness before.
It'll shatter me. I couldn't withstand it for even one second last time.
If it covers me while my mind is still blank, my mind will disappear before my body.

page28.text:
My body withers.
My body temperature drops to zero in an instant.
It's more suffocating and scary than I expected, so I move my body to try and get out.
But I can't jump.
There's no ground to push off of.
I'm going to...

page29.text:
"Ah...eh?"
I come to my senses in the backyard.
Purple hair fills my field of view.

page30.text:
"Rider, you..."
"This was your command, Sakura. You told me to protect Shirou Emiya, no matter what."

page31.text:
"Ri...der..."
Rider rescued me from the black wave.
"Try not to move. If you stand up in that condition, you will lose consciousness."
...
...Um, I'm not even thinking about that.
On my hands and knees, the act of breathing threatens to knock me out.

page32.text:
"...Oh. So you're going to oppose me, Rider.
Then I'll take you, too. I ate something I didn't expect earlier, so I don't need any more Servants...
But I'll do to you what I did to Saber."

page33.text:
...Shadows rise.
Sakura shrouds the entire yard in darkness. She isn't holding back anymore, after Rider's betrayal.

page34.text:
...The area around us is already covered in black.
Rider makes no sign of running. She just watches the creeping shadows approach, like a criminal awaiting execution.

page35.text:
"That's enough. You don't need to do all this, Sakura.
There's no going back if you swallow anything else."

page37.text:
"...What do you mean, Illyasviel?"
"Exactly what I said. You can consume Rider, kill Shirou, and neutralize Rin, but it's pointless to you right now. You're just wasting time, so why don't you stop the temper tantrum already?"

page38.text:
...What is she doing?
Illya is walking towards Sakura.

page39.text:
...
"You're here for me, right? Then let's get this over with. I'll come along peacefully, so leave them alone."

page40.text:
"Are you insane? All I want is your heart.
You're saying that you don't mind me killing you."
"I know that. But I'm going to get killed regardless, so it's pointless to resist. For now, you're the strongest one here."

page41.text:
Illya is calm.
...
...It's vexing.
I muster my body and every shred of my frayed mind to try and understand what Illya's saying, but I can't.

page42.text:
"So you're offering yourself up as a sacrifice, Illyasviel?"
"Yeah. It's my job.
But my dress isn't here. If you want to open the gate as a successor, you'll need to take me to my castle."
...

page43.text:
"And you've settled your scores, haven't you?
There's no need to kill Shirou.
You let that part of you in because you didn't want to kill anyone else, but now you're saying you have to kill them all. You're contradicting yourself, Sakura."
"Ngh..."

page44.text:
...The shadows recede.
Even the mud covering Tohsaka fades away as if it was never there.

page45.text:
"...Fine. It saves me the trouble of looking for it myself.
I don't know what you're playing at, but I'll go along with it."
Her long hair sways.
Sakura turns her back on us, as if she's completely lost interest in me and Rider. She starts to leave.

page46.text:
"Sakura...!"
Still on my knees, I call out to her.
"..."

page47.text:
"...Don't come to me anymore.
If I see you in front of me...I'll have to kill you, Senpai."

page48.text:
Sakura grows distant.
I can't follow her or call out to her.

page49.text:
"Sakura's right. Your role in this is done, Shirou.
It's my duty to take care of the rest. Sakura's going to take me away, so you can rest now."

page52.text: I hear her bid me a sad farewell.

page53.text:
...
Finally, I unfreeze.
My uncontrollable shaking in front of the Shadow,
and my guilt for thinking Sakura was someone else finally stop.

page54.text:
It's infuriating.
I was so pathetic that I couldn't even take Sakura's hand.
And that's not all.
At the very end, I let Illya make such a face when she called me her big brother!

page55.text:
"YOU DUMBASS!!!"
I run.
I chase after them with reckless abandon, pushing through the nausea, the chill, and my soup-like brain.

page56.text:
"Do not follow them. I'll kill you if you go any further."
"Ngh...!"
A black-armored Servant stands in my way.
She's been silent this entire time, and now she overwhelms me with her grim presence, sword pointed at me.

page57.text:
"...Move, Saber. I can't let them leave."
"And I can't let you go. I will not allow you to follow them... What could you do anyway, even if I did move?"

page58.text:
...
"...This is my last warning. One way or another, Sakura will obtain the Holy Grail. It is the only way to set her free.
She will be saved, even if she dies as a result."

page59.text:
"If you want to help Sakura, then stand down.
But if you still intend to chase her...then I will remove your head."

page60.text:
The dark Saber disappears.
Sakura and Illya are gone.
They vanish from sight, as if sinking into her shadow.

page61.text:
"Kuh..."
I run out of the will to move my body.
My arms and legs go limp, like a puppet with its strings cut.
"Damn..."
